title: finding(fields): openNativePicker has zero test coverage — DateField is its sole router and no case fires a click
body:
Found while implementing #7336 (standard-widget suite coverage). Filed rather than fixed there: that card is `p3` and scoped to one file's documentation-of-absence, and this is a separate gap in a different file.

## The reading

`packages/fields/src/widgets/openNativePicker.ts` is mentioned by **zero** test files in the repo.

```
$ git grep -l 'openNativePicker' -- '*.test.ts' '*.test.tsx'
(no output)

# lit control, same instrument, same pass — the sibling helper DateField
# also routes through, which DOES have coverage:
$ git grep -l 'toDateInputValue' -- '*.test.ts' '*.test.tsx'
packages/fields/src/widgets/nativeDateValue.test.ts
```

The control answers, so the instrument reaches helper names in test files and the zero is a real absence rather than a broken pattern.

## Why it is worth recording

`DateField` is its **sole** router — it is called from exactly one place, the `onClick` handler in `packages/fields/src/widgets/DateField.tsx`:

```tsx
onClick={(e) => {
  openNativePicker(e.currentTarget);
  domProps.onClick?.(e);
}}
```

`DateField` itself is well covered (`packages/fields/src/datetime-widgets.test.tsx` holds a full dedicated block, and `__tests__/date-locale-channel.test.tsx` pins the locale channel), but **none of those cases fires a click**, so the picker call is never exercised. The two things a test could pin that nothing currently does: that the helper is invoked at all, and that it does not swallow a host-supplied `onClick` passed through DOM props.

⚠️ **Not claimed:** that this is a live defect. No wrong behaviour was observed — this is a recorded coverage absence, the same class as #7336, and it is unquantified in the same way.

No assignee — recording, not claiming.
